drafts.subject: New supplier with no vendor record: invoice GPM-0142 ($4,510.00) on hold
drafts.body:
Hi team,

We've received invoice GPM-0142 dated 3 September 2026 from Geelong Precision Maintenance Pty Ltd (ABN 70 930 658 512) for $4,510.00 inc GST. They aren't in the vendor master and the invoice has no PO number. The only reference is 'Job 142, requested by plant maintenance'.

Could you please:
1. Work out who engaged this supplier (plant maintenance looks like the starting point).
2. If they are a legitimate new supplier, onboard them properly, including an ABN check and independently verified bank details. Please don't take bank details from the invoice alone.
3. Make sure a PO or non-PO approval is in place before anything is paid.

The invoice is on hold until that's done. Please let AP know the outcome.

Thanks,
Accounts Payable, Corio Packaging
